summary: New auth features (forgot password, reset, verify email, change password, resend verification, login lockout) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases passed (test_auth_flows.py) covering token creation in db.email_tokens, lockout (5 wrong attempts → HTTP 423 on next), reset with token+reuse rejection, verify-email flow (user.email_verified flips to true), change-password (401 wrong current + success + old-pw invalidated), resend-verification (new token created, no enumeration on unknown email). Frontend: 9/9 UI flows passed via Playwright - login-forgot-link navigates to /forgot-password, forgot-password success panel, /reset-password missing-token state + inputs render with ?token=, /verify-email valid+invalid states, dashboard user-menu opens with Change password + Sign out, Change password dialog submits and shows 'Password updated' toast. No new issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 848 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, datasets, ml, chat, reports). Same recommendation from iteration_1 still stands.
In login handler, when attempts hit MAX (5th failure), failed_attempts is reset to 0 and locked_until is set. Message returned is 'Locked for 15 min' - matches spec.
email tokens have no TTL index; expired tokens accumulate. Consider a Mongo TTL index on expires_at (or a scheduled cleanup) - non-blocking.
resend-verification does not invalidate previous unused verify tokens. All prior tokens remain valid until they expire. Low security impact for verification but worth noting.
forgot-password does not throttle by IP/email → a bad actor could spam email sends (Resend rate-limit will help but consider a per-email cooldown).
Change password does not invalidate existing JWTs / sessions (JWTs remain valid until natural 7-day expiry). Consider bumping a token version or clearing sessions on password change.
